A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Intramuscular Fat

1 Loading packages and data

## Load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data
data_IMF <- read.csv("IMF.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_IMF$Mean <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Mean)
data_IMF$SD <- as.numeric(data_IMF$SD)
data_IMF$Sample <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Sample)
data_IMF$Age <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Age)
data_IMF$Weight <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Weight)
data_IMF$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Digestible_energy)
data_IMF$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Crude_protein)
data_IMF$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Crude_fat)
data_IMF$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Crude_fiber)
data_IMF$Ash <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Ash)
data_IMF$Lys <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Lys)
data_IMF$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Met_and_Cys)
data_IMF$Thr <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Thr)
data_IMF$Try <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Try)
data_IMF$Val <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Val)
data_IMF$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Dry_matter)
data_IMF$Ca <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Ca)
data_IMF$P <- as.numeric(data_IMF$P)
data_IMF$Na <- as.numeric(data_IMF$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_IMF$Position <- factor(data_IMF$Position)
data_IMF$Breed <- factor(data_IMF$Breed)
data_IMF$Class <- factor(data_IMF$Class)
data_IMF$Sex <- factor(data_IMF$Sex)
data_IMF$Region <- factor(data_IMF$Region)
data_IMF$Aim <- factor(data_IMF$Aim)
data_IMF$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_IMF$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_IMF$rVar <- (data_IMF$SD / sqrt(data_IMF$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_IMF_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_IMF, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_IMF_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_IMF_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_IMF, method = "ML")
summary(null_IMF_mod) #3823.3708         
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1032; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1908.6854   5538.1673   3823.3708   3838.1886   3823.3941   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  1.2483  1.1173   1032     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  1.2687  1.1264    469     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1031) = 1884895.1943, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   3.2562  0.0673  48.4077  <.0001  3.1244  3.3880  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Ar_IMF_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_IMF_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_IMF, method = "ML")

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
IMF_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_IMF_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_IMF, method = "ML")

R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(IMF_full_mod)*100, 2)

anova(IMF_full_mod,null_IMF_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik       LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    288 3222.1963 4644.7014 3446.2394 -1323.0982                    46428.5962 
## Reduced   3 3823.3708 3838.1886 3823.3941 -1908.6854 1171.1745 <.0001 1884895.1943
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
IMF_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_IMF_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_IMF, method = "ML")

R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(IMF_Position_mod)*100, 2)

anova(IMF_Position_mod,null_IMF_mod)

## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region",
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1],
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_IMF_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_IMF_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      ~1 |Position),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_IMF, method = "REML")
summary(REML_IMF_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1032; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1692.4256   3384.8512   3396.8512   3426.4809   3396.9333   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.4965  0.7046   1032     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.8477  0.9207    469     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.1140  0.3377     56     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  1.3909  1.1794    211     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  1.1409  1.0681     21     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1031) = 1884895.1943, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   3.6156  0.3011  12.0084  <.0001  3.0255  4.2058  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values 
round(i2_ml(REML_IMF_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID   I2_Region    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##       99.94       12.44       21.23        2.86       34.84       28.58
# Calculate R-squared (marginal)
round(r2_ml(REML_IMF_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          87.56
p_REML_IMF <- orchard_plot(REML_IMF_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Intramuscular Fat Content",
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)

print(p_REML_IMF)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_IMF_B3 <- data_IMF %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_IMF_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_IMF_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 | RowID,
                               ~1 | StudyID,
                               ~1 | Region,
                               ~1 | Position)

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_IMF_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_IMF_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_IMF_B3)

summary(Br_VCV_REML_IMF_mod_int)

## Filter data for complete cases of Age

## Create VCV matrix for Age data

                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 | RowID,
                                    ~1 | StudyID,
                                    ~1 | Region, 
                                    ~1 | Breed, 
                                    ~1 | Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_IMF_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_IMF_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous,
  plot_name   = "p_IMF_Age",     
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",

  mods      = mods_list_age,

  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)

  kable(format = "html",digits = 4) %>%

  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")

3.22 CP_DE_ratio

## Filter data for non-missing Crude_protein and Digestible_energy, then calculate ratio
data_IMF_CP_DE_ratio <- data_IMF %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Crude_protein),
    !is.na(Digestible_energy),
    Digestible_energy != 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CP_DE_Ratio = Crude_protein / Digestible_energy
  )

## Create VCV matrix

  random_list = random_structure_continuous,

  y_lab       = "Intramuscular Fat Content (%)"

  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table
html_table_lys_de <- tbl_IMF_Lys_DE_ratio %>%
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_lys_de)

3.24 Ca_P_ratio

## Filter data for non-missing Calcium and Phosphorus, then calculate ratio
data_IMF_Ca_P_ratio <- data_IMF %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Ca),
    !is.na(P),
    P != 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Ca_P_Ratio = Ca / P
  )

## Create VCV matrix
VCV_IMF_Ca_P_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_IMF_Ca_P_ratio, 
                                     V = "rVar", 
                                     cluster = "StudyID", 
                                     obs = "RowID")
## Run meta-regression for Ca_P_Ratio
res_IMF_Ca_P_ratio <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_IMF_Ca_P_ratio,          
  mod_var     = "Ca_P_Ratio",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous,
  plot_name   = "p_IMF_Ca_P_ratio",              
  x_lab       = "Ratio of calcium to phosphorus",
  y_lab       = "Intramuscular Fat Content (%)"
)

## Generate summary table
mods_list_ca_p <- attr(res_IMF_Ca_P_ratio$best_model, "mods_list")
aic_tab_ca_p   <- res_IMF_Ca_P_ratio$aic_table

tbl_IMF_Ca_P_ratio <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_ca_p, aic_tab_ca_p,
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table
html_table_ca_p <- tbl_IMF_Ca_P_ratio %>%
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_ca_p)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 | RowID,
                            ~1 | StudyID,
                            ~1 | Region, 
                            ~1 | Breed, 
                            ~1 | Position)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_IMF_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_IMF_AllData,
  mods = ~ Years,
  random = random_structure_Ye,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_IMF
)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_IMF_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1032; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1689.7946   3379.5891   3393.5891   3428.1503   3393.6987   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.4965  0.7046   1032     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.8378  0.9153    469     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.1252  0.3538     56     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  1.3958  1.1814    211     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  1.1347  1.0652     21     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 1030) = 1645005.0032, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 1030) = 2.2515, p-val = 0.1338
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate       se     tval    df    pval      ci.lb    ci.ub    
## intrcpt  -56.5628  40.1066  -1.4103  1030  0.1587  -135.2628  22.1371    
## Years      0.0298   0.0199   1.5005  1030  0.1338    -0.0092   0.0688    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_IMF_mod_int) * 100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.18          87.58
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_IMF <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_IMF_mod_int,
                                          mod = "Years",
                                          group = "StudyID",
                                          xlab = "Publication year",
                                          ylab = "Mean Intramuscular Fat Content",
                                          g = TRUE)

# Customize x-axis breaks for better readability
p_Ye_VCV_REML_IMF <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_IMF + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
 
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_IMF)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## sigma^2.4  1.3923  1.1800    211     no     Breed

## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 1030) = 1231824.0394, p-val < .0001
